sources.entry: OWASP Top Ten Web Application Security Risks

summary.title: OWASP Top 10 | OWASP Foundation
summary.one_liner: The OWASP Top 10 is the reference standard list of the most critical web application security risks, used as a first step toward more secure software development.
keywords: what are the most common web app vulnerabilities
takeaways: The OWASP Top 10 is a standard awareness document covering the most critical web application security risks, based on broad consensus.
The most current released version is the OWASP Top 10 2025; previous versions 2021 and 2017 are still available.
Organizations are encouraged to adopt the list and work to minimize these risks in their web applications.
Adopting the list is described as an effective first step toward changing an organization's software development culture toward producing secure code.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for the OWASP Top 10 project, a flagship OWASP project that presents the reference list of the most critical web application security risks. The page states that the latest release is the 2025 edition, links to the 2021 and 2017 editions, and notes older versions in the GitHub repository. It positions the document as an awareness standard for developers and companies, meant to be adopted as a first step toward more secure coding. The page text itself lists the individual risk categories only through links, so the specific risk names are not included in this text.
